descriere: Sets the access level for reading and writing parameters via the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Sets the display filter for parameters with the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Sets the mode of the operating display for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP) in the operating states "ready for operation" and "operation".

Sets the delay time until the background lighting of the Basic Operator Panel (BOP) is switched off. If no keys are actuated, then the background lighting automatically switches itself off after this time has expired.
Sets the required drive object that is active at the Basic Operator Panel (BOP) after booting.
Sets the device and basic drive commissioning. By appropriately setting this parameter, those parameters are filtered that can be written into in the various commissioning steps.

Sets the parameter filter to commission an encoder drive object. Setting this parameter filters out the parameters that can be written into in the various commissioning steps. For the BOP, this setting also causes the read access operations to be filtered.
Sets the password for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Acknowledges the password for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Runs the corresponding macro files. The selected macro file must be available on the memory card/device memory.
Setting for activating/de-activating the user-defined list for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP). If p0016 = 1, then it is only possible to access parameters in the parameter list (p0013).
Setting to reset the display in r0039 and r0041. Procedure: Set p0040 = 0 --> 1 The displays are reset and the parameter is automatically set to zero.
Sets the smoothing time constant for the following display values: r5515[1], r5516[1]

Setting to pre-assign/check the sampling times for the internal controller clock cycles for clock-synchronous PROFIdrive operation. Re p0092 = 1: The controller clock cycles are set so that clock synchronous PROFIdrive operation is possible. If it is not possible to change the controller clock cycles of the clock-cycle synchronous PROFIdrive operation, then an appropriate message is output. The pre-setting of the controller clock cycles can result in a derating of the Motor Module (e.g. p0115[0] = 400 µs --> 375 µs). When calculating the drive unit utilization (r9976), when using the fixed DCC runtime groups "Receive AFTER IF1 PROFIdrive PZD", "Send BEFORE IF1 PROFIdrive PZD", "Receive AFTER IF2 PZD" (from V4.4) and "Send BEFORE IF2 PZD" (from V4.4), then its maximum computing time load has already been calculated during ramp-up for isochronous operation and taken into account in r9976 (from V4.3). Re p0092 = 0: The controller clock cycles are set without any restrictions by the clock-cycle PROFIdrive operation (same as for up to V2.3). When calculating the drive unit utilization (r9976), when using the fixed DCC runtime groups "Receive AFTER IF1 PROFIdrive PZD", "Send BEFORE IF1 PROFIdrive PZD", "Receive AFTER IF2 PZD" (from V4.4) and "Send BEFORE IF2 PZD" (from V4.4), then its maximum computing time load has already been calculated during ramp-up for isochronous operation and taken into account in r9976 (from V4.3).
Executes an automatic device configuration. In so doing, p0099, p0107 and p0108 are appropriately set.

Defines whether the motor and drive converter power settings (e.g. rated motor power, p0307) are expressed in [kW] or [hp]. Depending on the selection, the rated motor frequency (p0310) is either set to 50 Hz or 60 Hz. For p0100 = 0, the following applies: The power factor (p0308) should be parameterized. For p0100 = 1, the following applies: The efficiency (p0309) should be parameterized.
Setting to activate/de-activate a drive object.

Pre-assignment of the sampling times in p0115. The clock cycles for the current controller / speed controller / flux controller / setpoint channel / position controller / positioning / technology controller are pre-assigned as follows:
The current controller sampling time (p0115[0]) is pre-assigned by selecting the minimum pulse frequency.

descriere_scurta: Current controller computing dead time mode
descriere: Sets the mode for the computing dead time of the current controller. 0: Offset (shifted) clocking, minimum computing dead time of each drive, automatic setting 1: Clocking at the same time, the dead time aligns itself to the dead time of the latest drive, automatic setting 2: Manual setting of the computing dead time, early transfer 3: Manual setting of the computing dead time, late transfer 4-6: As for 0-2, however, no early transfers are set for vectors
This parameter is pre-set as a function of the current controller sampling time (p0115[0]) and normally does not have to be changed.

descriere_scurta: Number of Power unit Data Sets (PDS)
descriere: Sets the number of Power unit Data Sets (PDS). The value corresponds to the number of power units connected together for a parallel circuit configuration.
Sets the number of Motor Data Sets (MDS).
Sets the number of Encoder Data Sets (EDS).
Sets the number of VSM2 data sets.
The VSM2 data set is assigned to a VSM2 evaluation using this parameter.

descriere_scurta: Voltage Sensing Module 2 detection via LED
descriere: Detects the Voltage Sensing Module 2 (VSM2) assigned to this infeed.

Sets the component number for the valve. This unique component number is assigned when parameterizing the topology. Only component numbers can be entered into this parameter that correspond to a valve.
Sets the component number for the expansion component (e.g. CX32, NX10) for CU-LINK. This unique component number is assigned when parameterizing the topology.
Setting to activate/de-activate a Hydraulic Module.
Sets the number of Command Data Sets (CDS).
Sets the number of Drive Data Sets (DDS).
Sets the rated voltage for the valve.
Sets the drive unit supply voltage (3-ph. AC). The value corresponds to the rms value of the phase-to-phase rated line supply voltage.
Sets the rated line frequency for the infeed.
Sets the power unit configuration.

Sets the line filter type for the Active Line Module (ALM). Using the line filter type, filter capacitance (p0221), filter resistance (p0222) and inductance (p0223) and resistance (p0224) of the reactor are pre-assigned. For an Active Line Module (ALM), the power is automatically selected corresponding to the Active Interface Module (AIM) and the line filter type (p0220) pre-set as follows: - "booksize" format: p0220 = 41 ... 45 - "chassis" format: p0220 = 10 ... 19
Sets the filter capacitance of the line filter (connected in a delta configuration). Index: [0] = Line filter [1] = Line filter optional

descriere_scurta: Infeed inductance between filter and power unit
descriere: Sets the inductance between the filter and power unit.

descriere_scurta: Infeed resistance between filter and power unit
descriere: Sets the resistance between the filter and power unit

descriere_scurta: Infeed inductance between line supply and filter
descriere: Sets the inductance between line supply and filter.

descriere_scurta: Infeed resistance between line supply and filter
descriere: Sets the resistance between the line supply and filter.

descriere_scurta: Infeed DC link capacitance, power unit
descriere: Sets the total DC link capacitance.

Setting the manipulated variable inhibit time. The manipulated variable inhibit time starts after controlling the shutoff valve (opening) or after switching-on the power supply voltage of the control valve and during this time keeps the velocity setpoint at zero.
Enter the inductance of a filter connected at the power unit output.
Enters the capacitance of a sine-wave filter connected at the power unit output.
Sets the number of reactors connected in series at the power unit output.
Sets the signal source for the external system pressure.

Sets the cooling type for booksize compact power units. This therefore defines whether for these power units, the internal air cooling is shut down and instead, the "Cold- Plate" cooling type is used.

descriere_scurta: Maximum operating time power unit fan
descriere: Sets the maximum operating time of the power unit fan. The pre-alarm (warning) is output 500 hours before this set value. The monitoring is de-activated with p0252 = 0.

Sets starting time 1 to monitor the cooling unit after power-on command. After powering up, the following signals must be present within starting time 1: - "RKA powered up" - "RKA liquid flow OK" When a fault occurs, an appropriate message is output.

Sets starting time 2 to monitor the cooling unit after power-on command. After powering up, the following signals must be present within starting time 2: - "RKA conductivity, no fault" - "RKA conductivity, no alarm" When a fault occurs, an appropriate message is output.

descriere_scurta: Cooling unit fault conductivity delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the fault "RKA: Conductive limit value exceeded" during operation. The fault is only output if, during operation, the conductivity exceeds the permissible fault value and the value remains for a longer time than is set in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: Cooling unit fault liquid flow delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the fault "RKA: Liquid flow too low". The fault is only output if the cause is present for a time longer than is set in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: (axis without system pressure measurement) = r0069 (axis with system pressure measurement).
descriere: Sets the configuration for the voltage measurement.

descriere_scurta: DC link voltage undervoltage threshold reduction
descriere: Sets the absolute value by which the threshold to initiate the undervoltage fault (F30003) is reduced.

descriere_scurta: DC link voltage offset alarm threshold
descriere: Sets the voltage threshold to initiate alarm A06810. The value represents an offset so that the alarm threshold is obtained from the total of r0296 and p0279.

Sets the maximum steady-state DC link voltage. When the DC link voltage setpoint reaches the threshold, alarm A06800 is output. The setpoint for the DC link voltage in p3510 is limited to the value in p0280. The voltage can be increased (boosted) using the modulation depth reserve controller. The modulation depth reserve (p3480) can be too low if p0210 (drive unit supply voltage) was incorrectly parameterized, a line overvoltage condition is present or a high reactive current is required.
Sets the alarm threshold for a line supply overvoltage condition. The setting is made as a percentage of the drive unit supply voltage (p0210).
Sets the alarm threshold for a line undervoltage condition. The setting is made as a percentage of the drive unit supply voltage (p0210).
Sets the shutdown threshold for the line supply undervoltage. The setting is made as a percentage of the drive unit supply voltage (p0210).

descriere_scurta: Line supply frequency exceeded alarm threshold
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for an excessively high line frequency.

descriere_scurta: Line supply frequency undershot alarm threshold
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for an excessively low line frequency.

Sets the response to a thermal overload condition of the power unit. The following quantities can result in a response to thermal overload: - heat sink temperature (r0037[0]). - chip temperature (r0037[1]). - power unit overload I2t (r0036). Possible measures to avoid thermal overload: - reduce the output current limit r0289 and r0067 (for closed-loop speed/velocity or torque/force control) or the output frequency (for U/f control) indirectly via the output current limit and the intervention of the current limiting controller). - reduce the pulse frequency (only for vector control). A reduction, if parameterized, is always realized after an appropriate alarm is output.

descriere_scurta: Power unit alarm with I2t overload
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for the I2t power unit overload. Drive: If this threshold is exceeded, an overload alarm is generated and the system responds as parameterized in p0290. Infeed: When the threshold value is exceeded, only an overload alarm is output.
Sets the fan run-on time after the pulses for the power unit have been canceled.
Setting to reset and automatically calculate filter and control (closed-loop) parameters.

descriere_scurta: System of units motor equivalent circuit diagram data
descriere: Sets the actual system of units for motor equivalent circuit diagram data.
Sets the number of pulses for a rotary encoder.
Sets the fine resolution in bits of the incremental position actual values.

descriere_scurta: Encoder control word Gn_STW signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the encoder control word Gn_STW according to PROFIdrive.
Sets the input terminal to connect probe 1.
Sets the input terminal to connect probe 2.

descriere_scurta: Invert measuring probe or equivalent zero mark
descriere: Setting to invert the digital input signals to connect a measuring probe or an equivalent zero mark.

Sets the behavior for the ENCODER fault response (motor encoder). This means, for example, if an encoder fault occurs, encoderless operation can be automatically selected with a shutdown behavior that can be selected.

descriere_scurta: Square-wave encoder maximum speed difference per sampling cycle /
descriere: Sets the maximum permissible speed difference within the current controller sampling time for squarewave encoders.

Sets the input terminal for selecting the reference mark via BERO/switching signal when performing referencing with several zero marks. The encoder interface supplies the position of the reference mark, which was detected immediately after the positive edge of the BERO signal.
Selects the input terminal for connecting an equivalent zero mark (external encoder zero mark).
Selects the trace signal to be output in r0497, r0498 and r0499 for encoder diagnostics.
Sets the technology application. The parameter influences the calculation of open-loop and closed-loop control parameters that is e.g. initiated using p0578.
Sets the system of units for the controller gains.

Sets the number of parameters in the inhibit list p0571. This number of parameters can be automatically excluded from the calculation of the motor and control parameters (see p0340, p0578), starting from index 0.
Setting to inhibit the calculation of reference parameters (e.g. p2000) when automatically calculating the motor and closed-loop control parameters (p0340, p3900).
Sets the input terminal for the measuring probe for speed actual value measurement.
Sets the edge to evaluate the measuring probe signal for speed actual value measurement. 0: 0/1 edge 1: 1/0 edge
Sets the number of pulses per revolution (e.g. for disks with holes).

Sets the maximum measuring time for the measuring probe. If a new pulse is not received before the maximum measuring time has expired, then the speed actual value in r0586 is set to zero. This timer is re-started with the next pulse.
Selects the units for the parameters of the technology controller. For p0595 = 1, 2, the reference quantity set in p0596 is not active.
Sets the reference quantity for the technological units. When changing over using changeover parameter p0595 to absolute units, all of the parameters involved refer to the reference quantity.
Sets the sensor type for the temperature measurement at input X21 (booksize) or X41 (chassis). The measured value is displayed in r0035.

descriere_scurta: Par_circuit power unit number, temperature sensor
descriere: Sets the power unit number to which the temperature sensor is connected. The value corresponds to the Power unit Data Set number (PDS) of the power unit. The number of power unit data sets is defined in p0120.
Sets the signal source to evaluate the motor temperature via a BICO interconnection.

descriere_scurta: Central measuring probe synchronizing signal signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the synchronizing signal (SYN) of the function "central measuring probe evaluation". The signal is used to synchronize the common system time between the master and slave.

descriere_scurta: Central measuring probe control word signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the control word of the function "central measuring probe evaluation".
Sets the evaluation technique for the "central measuring probe evaluation" function.

Runs the corresponding macro files. The binector inputs of the corresponding command data set are appropriately interconnected. The selected macro file must be available on the memory card/device memory.
Sets the bidirectional digital inputs/outputs as an input or output.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 8
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 8 (X122.9 / X121.7). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 9
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 9 (X122.10 / X121.8). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 10
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 10 (X122.12 / X121.10). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.
